page_note: Heavily damaged page (96.7% damage ratio) but content is unbroken anthropogonic/correspondential substrate. The page describes the molding of Adam and Eve: archons imprint the image of the Exalted One in the inward heart of the soul, mold Adam according to his likeness — but only as a counterfeit likeness, not in truth. Then a correspondential simile: human plasma is like a great noble woman, exceedingly wealthy, clothed in habits of freedom and ranks of dignity, hidden in her palace, while nobles and magnates desire her face from the street. This is classical correspondential teaching — both sides of the mapping remain within the cosmic/teaching register (the molding of Adam ↔ the hidden free noblewoman). No dialogue frame, no ecclesial vocabulary, no polemic, no exhortation present. Substrate dominant throughout.
